newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico announces new auto import regulations.
newsitem.headline: Mexico announces new auto import regulations.

text.p: Mexico's Trade Ministry on Monday announced new regulations to streamline vehicle imports and cut red tape entailed in marketing.

The announcement, which was published in the government's official gazette, incorporates provisions relating to automobiles in the North American Free Trade Agreement (NAFTA) and will take effect on Tuesday.

The new rules govern the value added by domestically manufactured parts and components that manufacturers must include for local production and lower the levels of compensatory tariffs levied on imported autoparts and vehicles.
The regulations also stipulate requirements for an autoparts manufacturer to be classified as a local producer.
